speaker: John Plant
title: Executive Chairman and CEO at Howmet Aerospace

speaker: John Plant
title: Executive Chairman and CEO at Howmet Aerospace
msg: We, we want to be very selective in deploying that capital and be convinced that it adds something to us and passes all of the gates that we wanna have with revenue synergy, which is always, possibly the most difficult to get. speaker: John Plant
title: Executive Chairman and CEO at Howmet Aerospace

speaker: John Plant

speaker: John Plant

speaker: John Plant
title: Executive Chairman and CEO at Howmet Aerospace

speaker: John Plant

speaker: John Plant
title: Executive Chairman and CEO at Howmet Aerospace

speaker: John Plant

speaker: John Plant
